Resource / dataset: PBS agriculture statistics portal
Formats & access mode: Statistical releases, tables and agricultural publications from the PBS statistics menu
Period / coverage: Periodic crop, livestock and agricultural series; latest release varies
Research uses / variables: Crop output, land use, yields and agriculture's contribution to production
Caveats / access / quality notes: Where relevant compare with Ministry of National Food Security and provincial agriculture departments.

Resource / dataset: Agricultural Census 2024 report and national Excel tables
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
Country report PDF: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/IAC-Country-Report-02-06-2026-2.pdf
Official table index: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/agriculture-census/
Formats & access mode: Country report PDF, national Excel tables, historic table directory
Period / coverage: 2024; historic agricultural census tables also listed
Research uses / variables: Farm size, land use/holdings, agricultural structure, crops/livestock-related ownership and mechanization context
Caveats / access / quality notes: Distinguish full-count census variables from parameters collected on sample basis; use table notes. The report and tables have different levels of geographic detail; examine table-specific notes about full enumeration versus sample estimates.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Agricultural Research Council research and agricultural publications
Formats & access mode: Scientific reports, crop studies, research papers and technical publications
Geographic detail: National, agro-ecological region or experimental site
Research uses / variables: Crop yields, crop management, livestock, soil/water, climate adaptation and productivity research
Caveats / access / quality notes: Research-trial results may not represent national farm conditions; assess sampling, sites and external validity.

Resource / dataset: Auditor-General of Pakistan audit reports
Formats & access mode: Audit reports, PDFs, audit observations and department-wise findings
Period / coverage: Annual and special reports; report years vary
Geographic detail: Federal/provincial entities as covered by specific audit
Research uses / variables: Public expenditure leakages, compliance, arrears, irregularities and programme implementation
Caveats / access / quality notes: An audit observation is not necessarily a final finding of criminal wrongdoing; read response/reconciliation sections.

Resource / dataset: Economic Census 2023: establishments and workforce tables
Formats & access mode: Excel and PDF tables; key findings report
Geographic detail: National, province and district; industry (PSIC), establishment type and employment category
Research uses / variables: Formal/nonfarm establishment distribution, local business density, enterprise size, sector composition and workforce mapping
Caveats / access / quality notes: Counts of establishments are not the same as firm output, turnover, productivity or current job vacancies. The page links to province/district and industry/employment-category tables; use current census definitions for establishment and employment counts.

Resource / dataset: Balochistan MICS and other provincial household surveys
Formats & access mode: PDF survey reports and source materials; raw data access varies
Period / coverage: Multiple survey years; portal currently lists a legacy MICS 2010 report
Research uses / variables: Women/child health, education, WASH, nutrition and household deprivation
Caveats / access / quality notes: The available report is old; treat as historical baseline and use the latest compatible household survey for current estimates.

Resource / dataset: KP Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey microdata
Formats & access mode: Microdata, questionnaires, technical reports and survey findings
Period / coverage: MICS round(s) listed by official portal; check the survey-specific page
Geographic detail: KP district / urban-rural domains as documented
Research uses / variables: Child and maternal health, education, household deprivation, nutrition, WASH and gender gaps
Caveats / access / quality notes: Use the survey-specific report for exact year and sampling frame; do not merge MICS waves without harmonization.

Resource / dataset: Punjab Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) 2024 and older waves
Formats & access mode: Key findings PDF; survey reports; microdata availability via official catalogue/MICS process
Geographic detail: Punjab; district-level domains depending on MICS wave
Research uses / variables: Women/child health, education, nutrition, child protection, WASH and household deprivations
Caveats / access / quality notes: The direct file listed is a key-findings report, not raw microdata; look for full report and microdata separately.

Resource / dataset: Sindh MICS 2018–19 report
Formats & access mode: PDF report and linked survey materials
Geographic detail: Sindh, district domains described in technical report
Research uses / variables: Child welfare, maternal health, education, WASH, nutrition, gender and household services
Caveats / access / quality notes: Full raw microdata may be separate from the report; check MICS data-access rules.

Resource / dataset: Punjab Child Labour Survey 2019–20
Formats & access mode: Survey report; data/microdata availability as shown in catalogue
Research uses / variables: Child labour prevalence, work type, schooling, age/sex and related household factors
Caveats / access / quality notes: Use definition of child labour in the survey, not generic child employment; verify any data access conditions.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Meteorological Department climate and station resources
Formats & access mode: Weather records, rainfall/climate reports, advisories and station observations as released
Research uses / variables: Rainfall anomalies, heat, drought, crop exposure and links between weather and poverty/livelihoods
Caveats / access / quality notes: Station coverage and data access vary; climate normals and daily observations are different products.

Resource / dataset: SECP data and statistics
Data owner / publisher: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
Formats & access mode: Regulatory statistics, industry reports, annual reports and tables
Geographic detail: Capital markets, insurance, regulated companies and corporate sectors
Research uses / variables: Market structure, company registrations, non-bank finance and regulatory trends
Caveats / access / quality notes: Coverage is limited to SECP-regulated domains and the tables actually published.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Software Export Board industry information and publications
Formats & access mode: IT-sector reports, industry programmes and export/skills publications where released
Research uses / variables: IT services/export trends, industry capacity, skill programmes and digital employment policy
Caveats / access / quality notes: For export series use SBP/BOP source data and reconcile definitions with PSEB reports.

Resource / dataset: PBS disability and functional-limitation statistics
Formats & access mode: Census tables and PDFs; links to NADRA administrative counts and historic survey tables
Geographic detail: National/provincial, rural/urban and age/sex categories in released tables
Research uses / variables: Disability inclusion, access gaps, demographic profiles and service planning
Caveats / access / quality notes: Census functional limitations may not be comparable with older disability definitions or registration counts.

Resource / dataset: National Disaster Management Authority situation reports and risk publications
Formats & access mode: Situation reports, hazard/risk reports, maps, emergency updates and PDFs
Research uses / variables: Flood/heat/disaster impact, affected population, loss estimates and preparedness planning
Caveats / access / quality notes: Early impact figures may be provisional; separate affected people, displaced people, deaths and damage estimates.

Resource / dataset: HEC Higher Education Statistics and university records
Formats & access mode: Institutional statistics, annual reports and publications
Geographic detail: National, province, institution and programme where published
Research uses / variables: University access, institutional distribution, enrolment, gender balance and higher-education capacity
Caveats / access / quality notes: Check whether counts include public/private institutions, affiliated colleges and distance learning.

Resource / dataset: National Achievement Test (NAT) 2023 and LaNA linking study
Formats & access mode: PDF reports and findings by province
Geographic detail: National/provincial; learning level and subject as reported
Research uses / variables: Learning performance, learning poverty signals, subject gaps and provincial comparisons
Caveats / access / quality notes: Assessment sample, grades, domains and scaling differ from enrollment statistics.

Resource / dataset: School census profiles and EMIS downloads
Data owner / publisher: Education Management Information System / relevant education authority
Formats & access mode: Downloadable school-level/administrative profile files for listed school census years, including primary, middle, high/higher-secondary, student and HR profiles.
Period / coverage: Published profile years include 2019–20 and 2021–22 on the catalogue; newer waves may be listed elsewhere
Geographic detail: Administrative units / school profiles where provided
Research uses / variables: School distribution, student enrolment, teacher staffing, school facilities and public education capacity
Caveats / access / quality notes: Coverage and update cycle may be provincial or system-specific; do not treat this page as a uniform national census without confirming its jurisdiction.

Resource / dataset: School and student profiles / Education Management Information System (EMIS)
Formats & access mode: School-census profiles and downloadable tables by school level; forms and proformas
Geographic detail: School-level / administrative reporting units covered by portal
Research uses / variables: School facilities, student counts, staffing, school access and local service gaps
Caveats / access / quality notes: This portal is a particular EMIS source; verify province, year, reporting coverage and whether a profile reflects updated school records.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Education Statistics 2023–24 and archives
Formats & access mode: Annual PDF reports and tables; older annual report archive
Period / coverage: 2023–24 latest listed report, plus prior years
Geographic detail: National, provincial, education level and school system
Research uses / variables: Enrollment, out-of-school estimates, teachers, schools, gender gaps, education finance and SDG-4
Caveats / access / quality notes: Administrative education statistics may omit unregistered/non-formal providers; check data year and source system.

Resource / dataset: Election Commission of Pakistan election results and reports
Formats & access mode: Constituency results, notices, election reports and documents
Geographic detail: National, provincial, constituency and polling levels according to release
Research uses / variables: Turnout, vote shares, competition, gender participation and electoral geography
Caveats / access / quality notes: Check whether results are provisional, consolidated or final; boundaries shift across elections.

Resource / dataset: OGRA price notifications, reports and sector publications
Formats & access mode: Official price notifications, reports and licensing/regulatory documents
Geographic detail: National; oil, gas and regulated entities
Research uses / variables: Fuel-price changes, gas tariffs, regulated sector costs and petroleum market structure
Caveats / access / quality notes: A notified price is a regulated benchmark, not necessarily the price paid by every consumer after taxes/subsidies.

Resource / dataset: PBS energy and mining statistics
Formats & access mode: Statistical tables and publications
Research uses / variables: Energy supply/demand, mining activity and related economic indicators
Caveats / access / quality notes: For regulatory details, cross-check NEPRA, OGRA and energy ministry records.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Stock Exchange Data Portal
Formats & access mode: Interactive share prices, trading volumes, company profiles, disclosures and financial statements
Period / coverage: Daily market data and current listed-company records
Research uses / variables: Listed-company performance, market concentration, valuation and disclosure monitoring
Caveats / access / quality notes: Price/financial history can depend on the product or data-access terms; market prices are not macroeconomic survey data.

Resource / dataset: Economic Affairs Division development assistance information
Formats & access mode: Official publications, project information, aid/loan summaries and financing documents
Period / coverage: Periodic; project and financing years vary
Research uses / variables: Foreign aid/loan composition, development-finance dependence and donor concentration
Caveats / access / quality notes: Commitments, disbursements and actual expenditures are distinct; don't treat them as interchangeable.

Resource / dataset: Punjab Women's Economic and Social Well-being Survey 2017–18
Formats & access mode: Survey report and listed microdata if released
Research uses / variables: Women's economic participation, household bargaining, well-being and gender-specific constraints
Caveats / access / quality notes: Check microdata availability and questionnaire; the survey is older and Punjab-specific.

Resource / dataset: PBS GIS and administrative-unit tables
Formats & access mode: GIS information, administrative-unit lists, maps and links to census/PSLM/HIES reports
Geographic detail: National, province, division, district, tehsil, mauza and census areas according to release
Research uses / variables: Create geographic joins, harmonize districts over time and map service coverage
Caveats / access / quality notes: Availability of GIS boundary files varies; some maps may be visual references rather than open shapefiles.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Spatial Insights: census mapping portal
Formats & access mode: Interactive GIS maps, boundary overlays and thematic maps
Geographic detail: Districts, tehsils, assembly constituencies and lower-level areas as available
Research uses / variables: Map spatial inequality, population density, road/rail overlays and geographic access to public services
Caveats / access / quality notes: Confirm boundary vintage, coordinate system and whether a layer is downloadable before joining external data.

Resource / dataset: Ministry of National Health Services and health-sector publications
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
National Digital Health & Knowledge Hub: https://ndhh.nhsrc.pk/
Ministry portal: https://www.nhsrc.pk/
Formats & access mode: Policy documents, health-sector reports, programme information and some statistics
Research uses / variables: Health-system administration, programme coverage and sector indicators
Caveats / access / quality notes: Portal is a ministry landing page, not one harmonized dataset; follow through to the specific programme/source. The hub aggregates system indicators, surveys, analytics and documents; verify whether a data stream is live, periodic, or a report-only series.

Resource / dataset: National Digital Health & Knowledge Hub (NDHH)
Data owner / publisher: Ministry of National Health Services / Pakistan health data partners
Formats & access mode: Searchable hub of information systems, surveys, analytics, visualizations, health indicators and policy/research documents; some linked systems are live, others report-based.
Period / coverage: Current portal; individual source periods vary
Geographic detail: National and subnational depending on connected system
Research uses / variables: Health systems, health financing, workforce, nutrition, essential services, disease surveillance, population, UHC/SDG3
Caveats / access / quality notes: Aggregator, not one homogeneous dataset. Record the underlying source/system, refresh date, definitions and access terms for each indicator.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey historical survey waves
Data owner / publisher: National Institute of Population Studies / DHS Program
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
Public data catalogue: https://www.nips.org.pk/viewpublicdata
DHS Program: https://dhsprogram.com/
Formats & access mode: Survey reports, questionnaires, technical documents and microdata for released waves; data access may require a short registration/request.
Period / coverage: Historical waves including 1990–91, 2006–07, 2012–13 and 2017–18; verify each record
Research uses / variables: Fertility, family planning, maternal/child health, nutrition, mortality and household determinants
Caveats / access / quality notes: Not a continuous annual series. Harmonize questionnaire changes, weights and sampling design when combining waves.

Resource / dataset: National Institute of Health Pakistan publications and surveillance resources
Formats & access mode: Disease advisories, technical reports, surveillance publications and health resources
Research uses / variables: Infectious disease surveillance context, laboratory/public-health trends and outbreak monitoring
Caveats / access / quality notes: Released surveillance aggregates may not expose underlying case line lists; confirm reporting definitions.

Resource / dataset: HIES 2024–25: microdata, questionnaires, manuals and reports
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
SPSS ZIP: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/SPSS-data-2.zip
Stata ZIP: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/Stata-data-1.zip
Full report PDF: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/HIES-2024-25-Report-Final-2.pdf
Social indicators PDF: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/HIES_Report_2024-25-Social-indicators-Reportupdated.pdf
Formats & access mode: SPSS and Stata compressed files; PDF reports; questionnaires; codebooks; manuals
Geographic detail: Pakistan incl. AJK and GB; provincial, urban/rural and consumption-quintile results
Research uses / variables: Household income/consumption, consumption poverty, inequality, food insecurity, ICT access, health spending, education, jobs, WASH, household assets and amenities
Caveats / access / quality notes: Use survey weights and codebook. PBS noted a corrected/re-uploaded Section 6 on 16 Jan 2026; confirm you have the corrected file. Direct links surfaced by the current PBS catalogue; confirm files, questionnaires and codebooks match the selected survey wave before analysis.

Resource / dataset: HIES and PSLM historical microdata archive
Formats & access mode: SPSS/Stata archives, questionnaires, coding schemes, manuals and PDF reports
Geographic detail: National / provincial; select older waves have district-level design
Research uses / variables: Long-run changes in consumption, household amenities, education, health, gender, WASH and poverty
Caveats / access / quality notes: Survey redesigns, sample frames, poverty methodology and variable names can change; do not append waves blindly.

Resource / dataset: PSLM–SDGs district dashboard
Formats & access mode: Interactive tables and dashboards
Period / coverage: Multiple PSLM rounds/indicators; dashboard coverage varies by indicator
Research uses / variables: Compare districts on education, literacy, health, WASH, assets and SDG-related social outcomes
Caveats / access / quality notes: Dashboard indicators may use different survey years; capture each indicator's source year and metadata.

Resource / dataset: PSLM District Level Survey 2019–20 microdata
Formats & access mode: SPSS/Stata files, questionnaires, coding schemes and PDF reports
Geographic detail: District level; urban/rural and demographic breakdowns subject to sample
Research uses / variables: Literacy, school attendance/enrolment, employment, disability/functional limitation, health services, WASH, assets and basic services
Caveats / access / quality notes: Check the exact round's sample design, indicator definitions and district reliability before small-area inference.

Resource / dataset: PBS industrial production and large-scale manufacturing statistics
Formats & access mode: Monthly tables/releases; Excel series linked under industry/statistics
Period / coverage: Monthly and annual depending on indicator
Research uses / variables: Industrial cycles, production declines, sector composition and correlation with electricity/import inputs
Caveats / access / quality notes: Index rebasing and product/sector weights may change; check methodology and revision notes.

Resource / dataset: Punjab Home Based Worker Survey 2016 and Home Based/Domestic Workers Survey 2022–23
Formats & access mode: Reports and any listed survey microdata
Research uses / variables: Home-based work, informal work, gender, work hours, wages and labour rights
Caveats / access / quality notes: Survey concepts and sampling may differ across waves; microdata availability is not guaranteed for every listed survey.

Resource / dataset: Labour Force Survey 2024–25 microdata, report and documentation
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
Stata ZIP: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/LFS-2024-25-STATA.zip
SPSS ZIP: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/LFS-2024-25-SPSS.zip
Report, questionnaire, codebook and classifications: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/labour-force-publications/
Formats & access mode: SPSS/Stata RAR files, annual report, questionnaire, codebooks, occupation/industry classifications and enumerator manual
Period / coverage: 2024–25; historical LFS files listed back to 2005–06
Geographic detail: National and provincial; district detail depends on design and release
Research uses / variables: Employment/unemployment, labour-force participation, wages, occupation/industry, informal work, gender gap, migration, training and disability
Caveats / access / quality notes: Use weights, survey strata/PSUs and the matching coding scheme; labour definitions can differ by survey year. Includes annual report, coding scheme, enumerator manual, technical/vocational course codes, occupation and industry classifications.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Employment Trend Report 2025
Formats & access mode: PDF report with tables/figures
Period / coverage: Published 2025; trends derived from official labour-force statistics
Research uses / variables: Employment structure and changes by sector, occupation, sex, age and other report dimensions
Caveats / access / quality notes: A publication/analysis layer, not a substitute for microdata; use the underlying LFS for custom cross-tabs.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Economic Survey 2025–26 full report and sector chapters
Formats & access mode: Full PDF, chapter PDFs, statistical appendix and highlighted indicators
Period / coverage: FY2025–26 (some statistics through a stated cut-off within FY2026)
Research uses / variables: A broad inventory of agriculture, industry, tax, fiscal balance, debt, inflation, health, education, labour, energy, IT, climate and social protection
Caveats / access / quality notes: Each chapter often cites a different producer and cut-off; trace figures to the source agency and note fiscal-year reference.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Economic Survey archive
Formats & access mode: Annual PDFs, chapter-wise reports and associated appendices
Period / coverage: Historical annual surveys; many years listed
Research uses / variables: Long-run official narrative and table-based analysis of the economy
Caveats / access / quality notes: Series definitions, policy regimes and statistical bases change between editions.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Economy Dashboard
Formats & access mode: Interactive sector dashboards; chart export as CSV/SVG/PNG where offered
Period / coverage: Current and historical economic indicators by dashboard
Geographic detail: National; many macro and sector series
Research uses / variables: Fast screening of GDP, fiscal, trade, debt, education, health, employment, energy, IT and social protection
Caveats / access / quality notes: A convenient presentation layer. Preserve the underlying series name and source rather than citing a screenshot alone. Exports are available for supported indicators/charts; check individual dashboard source notes and reference periods.

Resource / dataset: Economic Survey Statistical Supplement archive
Formats & access mode: Annual tables and PDF/Excel-like annexes depending on edition
Research uses / variables: Build historical tables for key economic/social variables that are hard to locate individually
Caveats / access / quality notes: Treat this as a compiled reference; source agency and series notes should travel with copied data.

Resource / dataset: Bureau of Emigration & Overseas Employment statistics
Formats & access mode: Annual reports, registered-emigrant statistics, country/occupation and administrative records
Period / coverage: Long-run annual series and current administrative records vary
Geographic detail: National, province/district and destination/country where released
Research uses / variables: Overseas job placements, occupations, destination shifts and labour export dependency
Caveats / access / quality notes: Counts of registered overseas workers do not cover informal/unregistered migration or every visa category.

Resource / dataset: Diaspora Database Dashboard: overseas Pakistani employment
Formats & access mode: Interactive dashboard, trend indicators and skill categories
Period / coverage: Yearly data with current-year and historical views displayed
Geographic detail: National and origin province; skill class and destination where available
Research uses / variables: Emigration for work, skill composition, region of origin and overseas employment trends
Caveats / access / quality notes: Registration counts reflect formal overseas employment channels; not all migration or all emigrants.

Resource / dataset: PBS annual and quarterly national accounts tables
Formats & access mode: Excel tables, quarterly releases, annual series, visualization and press releases
Period / coverage: Annual and quarterly GDP; series revised as national accounts estimates are updated
Research uses / variables: GDP growth, sector contribution, nominal vs real growth, rebasing and macroeconomic trend analysis
Caveats / access / quality notes: Use the most recent revised series consistently; historic estimates can be revised and rebased. Use the latest revised release and retain vintage/revision date when building time series.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan National Summary Data Page / NSDP
Formats & access mode: Indicator tables and metadata links
Period / coverage: Selected official macroeconomic and social indicators
Research uses / variables: Find internationally disseminated official data, indicator metadata and source agencies
Caveats / access / quality notes: Coverage is curated rather than exhaustive; follow links to the originating producer. A dissemination index; for source-level detail follow the indicator metadata to its originating department.

Resource / dataset: PBS statistics and microdata entry directory
Formats & access mode: Navigation to statistics, surveys, census, media releases and data insights
Research uses / variables: Discover PBS resources not yet listed, including social stats, industry, energy/mining, IT services and business register
Caveats / access / quality notes: A directory, not a dataset itself; use the item-specific page to download and record metadata.

Resource / dataset: SBP payment systems and financial inclusion publications
Formats & access mode: Quarterly review reports, annual reporting and sector tables where published
Research uses / variables: Digital payments, branchless banking, mobile wallets, account access and financial inclusion
Caveats / access / quality notes: Payment transactions may count transactions/accounts rather than unique users; avoid inferring individual inclusion directly.

Resource / dataset: SBP remittances, foreign reserves, FX rates and balance-of-payments series
Formats & access mode: Monthly/daily time series and downloadable datasets
Period / coverage: Long-run series; remittances from Jul 1972 and reserves from Jun 1948 are listed in catalogue
Geographic detail: National; worker remittances by country, reserve assets and currency series where available
Research uses / variables: Migration economics, external financing, current-account pressure, FX liquidity and remittance dependency
Caveats / access / quality notes: Different remittance series may be seasonally adjusted or classified differently; record exact series ID and unit.

Resource / dataset: SBP EasyData economic time-series portal
Formats & access mode: Interactive time series, dashboards, Excel/PDF downloads; API for some signed-in features
Period / coverage: Thousands of series; high-frequency series range from daily/weekly to annual
Research uses / variables: FX rates, remittances, reserves, trade, balance of payments, banking, credit, money, prices and FDI
Caveats / access / quality notes: SBP described 24,487 time-series and 3.11 million data points; API/My Data Basket may need sign-in. Portal supports series exploration and downloads; some baskets/API features may require sign-in.

Resource / dataset: SBP Economic Data and historical archive
Formats & access mode: Excel tables, statistical publications, dataset links and archives
Period / coverage: Historical and current series; GDP, trade, LSM, prices and other sectors
Research uses / variables: Retrieve series outside the more interactive EasyData interface and locate archived file versions
Caveats / access / quality notes: Older archives may use different page structures and data bases; confirm the latest revised dataset.

Resource / dataset: SBP data calendar / release schedule
Formats & access mode: Release calendar / expected publication dates
Research uses / variables: Automate data monitoring and distinguish publication lags from missing series
Caveats / access / quality notes: Expected dates can change; capture actual release date and time series version separately.

Resource / dataset: SBP EasyData dataset catalogue with frequency and date coverage
Formats & access mode: Searchable dataset listing with frequency, source, available-from/to and release date
Period / coverage: Historical series include remittances from 1972 and foreign reserves from 1948 for some variables
Geographic detail: National, country/sector/category disaggregation depending on series
Research uses / variables: Choose precise series for a reproducible economic time series and track update cadence
Caveats / access / quality notes: The catalogue URL can contain session-specific parameters; if it expires, open EasyData and navigate to Datasets.

Resource / dataset: Planning Commission publications and Monthly Development Update
Data owner / publisher: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
Formats & access mode: PDF publications, development updates, annual reports and policy briefs
Period / coverage: Periodic; recent releases include 2026 development updates
Research uses / variables: Development priorities, macro/development monitoring, public projects and SDG progress
Caveats / access / quality notes: Reports synthesize source data and may be selective; use the annexes/source notes for further retrieval.

Resource / dataset: Census 2023 interactive demographic and housing dashboard
Formats & access mode: Interactive charts, maps and tables
Geographic detail: National down to mouza level where available
Research uses / variables: Housing quality, household amenities, population pyramid, education, internet, electricity, gas and water access
Caveats / access / quality notes: Dashboard outputs are useful for discovery; download matching official tables for reproducible citations.

Resource / dataset: Population & Housing Census 2023 detailed tables
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
Excel table library: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/result-excel/
Census portal: https://census23.pbos.gov.pk/
GIS/admin tables: https://www.pbs.gov.pk/gis/
Formats & access mode: Excel tables, PDF reports, gazette notifications, enumerator questionnaires and technical documentation
Geographic detail: National, province, district, tehsil and some lower units/tables
Research uses / variables: Population growth, density, household size, sex/age structure, literacy, education, housing, utilities and urbanization
Caveats / access / quality notes: Compare administrative boundaries carefully across census years; note census revisions, coverage and enumeration definitions. Select the right geographic level and table definition; province/district figures and locality-level tables are not always directly comparable.

Resource / dataset: NIPS public microdata catalogue
Formats & access mode: SPSS/Stata files, survey reports and survey-related material
Period / coverage: PDHS 1990–91, 2006–07, 2012–13, 2017–18; Maternal Mortality Survey 2019 among listed items
Geographic detail: Pakistan; sample-specific sub-national coverage varies by survey
Research uses / variables: Fertility, maternal/child health, mortality, reproductive health, household demographics and related public-health questions
Caveats / access / quality notes: Some data may require application or account; use survey weights and the release's anonymization/permission rules.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Demographic and Health Survey 2017–18 files at NIPS
Formats & access mode: SPSS/Stata microdata, full survey reports and questionnaires
Geographic detail: Nationally representative with sub-national domains as reported
Research uses / variables: Maternal/child health, fertility, family planning, nutrition, sanitation, immunization and household wealth
Caveats / access / quality notes: Read the sampling and recode documentation carefully; this is a household survey, not a complete health administrative census.

Resource / dataset: PBS Census archive: historical population, education and activity tables
Formats & access mode: PDF and Excel tables by province/territory
Period / coverage: Historical census tables including 1998 and earlier series where listed
Research uses / variables: Long-run demographic, educational attainment, economic activity and household trend analysis
Caveats / access / quality notes: Older categories/boundaries may not align with 2017 or 2023; document concordance assumptions.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan Demographic Survey 2020 microdata
Formats & access mode: SPSS RAR microdata, codebook, questionnaire, PDF reports and time-series visualizations
Period / coverage: 2020; historical PDS reports/tables back to early 2000s
Geographic detail: National demographic estimates; disaggregation depends on released files/design
Research uses / variables: Births, deaths, crude birth/death rates, infant mortality, fertility and population change
Caveats / access / quality notes: Vital events estimates have sampling and recall limits; don't assume the survey captures every vital event. Check sampling, coding scheme and release notes; not equivalent to the larger PDHS household survey.

Resource / dataset: Pakistan poverty estimation 2024–25
Data owner / publisher: Planning Commission / Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
Official report library: https://pc.gov.pk/web/sdgreport
Other publications: https://pc.gov.pk/web/publication
Formats & access mode: Official poverty-estimation PDF based on the Cost of Basic Needs approach and HIES 2024–25; associated poverty and inequality reports.
Geographic detail: National and provincial; breakdowns depend on report tables
Research uses / variables: Poverty line, consumption poverty, poverty trends and comparisons
Caveats / access / quality notes: The report is a statistical estimate, not public-use household microdata. Retain method and threshold definitions, and avoid mixing with MPI without stating the distinction.

Resource / dataset: Planning Commission SDG, poverty and development report library
Data owner / publisher: Ministry of Planning, Development & Special Initiatives
Direct file URL(s) / acquisition link:
Poverty estimation 2024–25 and SDG reports: https://pc.gov.pk/web/sdgreport
Planning Commission publications: https://pc.gov.pk/web/publication
Formats & access mode: PDF reports: poverty estimation 2024–25, SDG status, national poverty/inequality and MPI reports
Period / coverage: Latest poverty estimation uses HIES 2024–25; earlier poverty/MPI reports also listed
Geographic detail: National/provincial, district or indicator-specific where provided
Research uses / variables: Official national poverty lines, trend estimates, multidimensional deprivation and SDG status
Caveats / access / quality notes: Poverty estimate is methodology-sensitive; read the official technical note and compare only compatible series. For the 2024–25 poverty estimate, retain the Cost of Basic Needs method and HIES survey-year metadata.

Resource / dataset: NEPRA annual reports, State of Industry and performance reports
Formats & access mode: PDF reports, tariff decisions, performance indicators and regulatory publications
